title: Book of Enoch cut from the Tanakh

tellings.quote: backstory here. And you find the backstory preserved in the book of Enoch, which was first discovered in Ethiopia. And he clearly was at one point part of the Tanakh and was excised,

plain: A philosopher named Jason Jorjani says that an ancient text called the Book of Enoch, first found in Ethiopia, preserves a backstory to a short passage in Genesis, the first book of the Bible. He says Enoch was once part of the Tanakh, the Hebrew Bible, and was later cut out of it. If true, it would mean part of the original religious story was deliberately removed.
